<template>
  <view class="publish-page">
    <view class="publish-header">
      <text class="publish-title">发布社区动态</text>
      <text class="publish-tip">分享真实体验，帮助更多邻居</text>
    </view>

    <view class="form-card">
      <textarea
        class="content-input"
        maxlength="500"
        placeholder="说说商品体验、社区活动或闲置好物..."
        value="{{content}}"
        bindinput="updateContent"
      />
      <text class="word-count">{{content.length}} / 500</text>

      <view class="photo-grid">
        <view class="photo-item" wx:for="{{photos}}" wx:key="tempFilePath">
          <image class="photo-image" src="{{item.tempFilePath}}" mode="aspectFill" />
          <view class="photo-remove" catchtap="removePhoto(index)" aria-role="button" aria-label="删除图片">
            <text>×</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view
          wx:if="{{photos.length < 9}}"
          class="photo-add"
          bindtap="choosePhoto"
          aria-role="button"
          aria-label="添加图片"
        >
          <text class="photo-add-icon">+</text>
          <text class="photo-add-label">添加图片</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="publish-options">
      <view class="option-row" bindtap="choosePlace">
        <view class="option-main">
          <text class="option-icon">⌖</text>
          <view class="option-copy">
            <text class="option-label">所在位置</text>
            <text class="option-value">{{place.name || '选择位置'}}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <text class="option-arrow">›</text>
      </view>

      <view wx:if="{{place.name}}" class="place-card" bindtap="openPlace">
        <view class="place-copy">
          <text class="place-name">{{place.name}}</text>
          <text class="place-address">{{place.address}}</text>
        </view>
        <text class="place-action">查看地图</text>
      </view>

      <view class="option-row">
        <view class="option-main">
          <text class="option-icon">#</text>
          <view class="option-copy">
            <text class="option-label">社区话题</text>
            <picker mode="selector" range="{{topics}}" range-key="name" bindchange="selectTopic">
              <text class="option-value">{{selectedTopic.name || '选择话题'}}</text>
            </picker>
          </view>
        </view>
        <text class="option-arrow">›</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="publish-notice">
      <switch checked="{{allowComments}}" bindchange="toggleComments" color="#1677ff" />
      <text class="notice-text">允许其他用户评论</text>
    </view>

    <button
      class="publish-button"
      loading="{{submitting}}"
      disabled="{{!canSubmit || submitting}}"
      bindtap="submitPost"
    >
      发布动态
    </button>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    content: '',
    photos: [],
    place: {},
    topics: [
      { id: 'shopping', name: '社区好物' },
      { id: 'activity', name: '邻里活动' },
      { id: 'secondhand', name: '闲置交换' },
      { id: 'service', name: '便民服务' }
    ],
    selectedTopic: {},
    allowComments: true,
    submitting: false
  },
  computed: {
    canSubmit () {
      return Boolean(this.content.trim() || this.photos.length)
    }
  },
  methods: {
    updateContent (event) {
      this.content = event.detail.value
    },
    choosePlace () {
      wx.chooseLocation({
        success: (place) => {
          this.place = place
        }
      })
    },
    openPlace () {
      if (!this.place.latitude || !this.place.longitude) return
      wx.openLocation({
        latitude: this.place.latitude,
        longitude: this.place.longitude,
        name: this.place.name,
        address: this.place.address
      })
    },
    choosePhoto () {
      wx.chooseMedia({
        count: 9 - this.photos.length,
        mediaType: ['image'],
        sourceType: ['album', 'camera'],
        success: ({ tempFiles }) => {
          this.photos = this.photos.concat(tempFiles)
        }
      })
    },
    removePhoto (index) {
      this.photos.splice(index, 1)
    },
    selectTopic (event) {
      this.selectedTopic = this.topics[Number(event.detail.value)]
    },
    toggleComments (event) {
      this.allowComments = event.detail.value
    },
    submitPost () {
      if (!this.canSubmit || this.submitting) return
      this.submitting = true
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/community/posts',
        method: 'POST',
        data: {
          content: this.content,
          photos: this.photos.map(item => item.tempFilePath),
          place: this.place,
          topicId: this.selectedTopic.id || '',
          allowComments: this.allowComments
        },
        success: ({ data }) => {
          wx.redirectTo({ url: `/pages/community/detail?id=${data.id}` })
        },
        fail: () => {
          wx.showToast({ title: '发布失败，请重试', icon: 'none' })
        },
        complete: () => {
          this.submitting = false
        }
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<style>
.publish-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 24rpx;
  background: #f6f7fb;
}

.publish-header {
  padding: 20rpx 8rpx 28rpx;
}

.publish-title,
.publish-tip,
.word-count,
.photo-add-label,
.option-label,
.option-value,
.place-name,
.place-address,
.place-action,
.notice-text {
  display: block;
}

.publish-title {
  color: #20232a;
  font-size: 38rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.publish-tip {
  margin-top: 8rpx;
  color: #8a8f99;
  font-size: 24rpx;
}

.form-card,
.publish-options {
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 20rpx;
}

.form-card {
  padding: 24rpx;
}

.content-input {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 240rpx;
  color: #333333;
  font-size: 28rpx;
  line-height: 42rpx;
}

.word-count {
  color: #b4b8c0;
  font-size: 22rpx;
  text-align: right;
}

.photo-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 20rpx;
}

.photo-item,
.photo-add {
  width: 196rpx;
  height: 196rpx;
  margin: 0 16rpx 16rpx 0;
  border-radius: 14rpx;
}

.photo-item {
  position: relative;
}

.photo-image {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 14rpx;
}
